name: GenerateReceiptPdf
description: Builds the receipt PDF of one receipt (Receipts.receiptKey) from the one shared Hebrew RTL HTML template (code-actions/shared, next to the statement template, same look) and converts it with the platform HtmlToPdf action: Ciment header, receipt number = receiptKey, customer name, code and ח.פ, value date, amount, payment method (העברה בנקאית / זיכוי בנק), bank reference and payer name, "על חשבון" until the allocation, the signing bookkeeper, and – until Priority is connected – the stamp "הופק באפליקציה – טרם הונפק ב-Priority" (plus "טיוטה – ממתינה לאישור" while the receipt is not approved). IssueReceipt attaches exactly this PDF to the mail draft; the screen previews and downloads the same url. Writes no rows and sends nothing.
usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Viewing a receipt**: Clicking "PDF" on an approved line in the customer identification list on the "תקבולים" screen
  Makes the receipt's PDF and shows it in a window with a download link. It is the same file that is attached to the mail draft for the customer.
